wrap.home.faq1_a: A UV template is a flat 2D map of a car's body panels. Anything you draw on it is projected onto the matching panel of the 3D model, so you can see how a design lines up on the hood, doors and trunk before you export.
wrap.home.faq2_q: Is this an official Tesla tool?
wrap.home.faq2_a: No. This is an independent, fan-made tool for creating custom wraps for Tesla's Paint Shop feature. It is not affiliated with Tesla, Inc.
wrap.home.faq3_q: Does this change my actual car's paint?
wrap.home.faq3_a: No. Paint Shop wraps only change how your car looks on the touchscreen and in the Tesla app. Your physical paint is not affected.
wrap.home.faq4_q: Which Tesla wrap templates are available?
wrap.home.faq4_a: Cybertruck, Model 3 (including the 2024+ Standard, Premium and Performance), Model Y (including the 2025+ Standard, Premium, Performance and Model Y L), Model S and Model X.
wrap.home.faq5_a: The editor runs in your browser. Images you upload and designs you save stay on your device unless you choose to generate with AI or share a design.
wrap.home.about_desc: {brand} is a free online designer for Tesla Paint Shop wraps. Pick your model, paint on its template, preview the result on a 3D car and export a PNG that is ready for your Tesla.
